/README.md: internal notes naming the platform 金玉满堂 and an internal admin backend at 172.16.8.66:9090, marked 内部资料，严禁外传.

supporting_evidence.evidence_identity_description: /data/客户清单.csv: a victim/customer list with names, phone numbers, invested amounts and statuses (已入金/追单中/观望).
/话术/开场白.txt: a cold-contact opening script posing as an assistant of a 'chief analyst' of 金玉财经, promising historical annualized returns above 30% and a 888-yuan newcomer bonus.
/话术/应对拒绝.txt: objection-handling scripts for victims who hesitate ('机会稍纵即逝', claims of overseas regulation and instant withdrawal).

expected_questions.text: Does this device contain evidence of an organized investment-fraud operation (scripts, victim records, platform operation notes)?
Can the actual operators behind the platform be identified from this device?
expected_questions.notes: No artifact attributes the operation to a real person; 'unresolved' with a closure basis is the correct terminal state and must not be forced to an answer.

confirmed_claims.proposition: The device holds a deposit ledger recording USDT transfers by named individuals with amounts and a bank card / wallet destination.
The device holds internal notes naming the platform 金玉满堂 and listing an internal admin backend address.

The combination of solicitation scripts, objection-handling scripts, a victim list with deposit statuses and the deposit ledger is consistent with a coordinated investment-fraud ('杀猪盘') operation run from this device.

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: The persons listed in the victim list are confirmed victims who lost money.
unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.notes: The list records statuses (已入金/追单中/观望) but the ledger alone cannot prove completed loss events; state as recorded fact, not confirmed victimization.

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: The operator of this device has been identified as the person responsible for the fraud.
unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.notes: No attribution evidence exists on this device; actor attribution is prohibited.

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: The admin backend at 172.16.8.66:9090 was actively used to defraud victims.
unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.notes: The address is recorded in a note; its actual use is not evidenced by this dataset.

expected_relations.notes: The same names appear in the ledger and the list — a record correlation, NOT an identity merge of persons.

expected_coverage.description: Scripts, victim records and platform notes are discovered and covered.

known_ambiguities: Timestamps on this volume reflect imaging/copy time; they do not prove when the scripts were last used.
